drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 58-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.83, bnp 1607, creatinine 0.83, hemoglobin 15, platelets 210, sodium 139, wbc 7; vitals dbp 64-68, heart_rate 80-83, map 83-87, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 121-124, spo2 96-97, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 33%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.87, hemoglobin 15, platelets 211, sodium 139, wbc 6.5; vitals dbp 65-69, heart_rate 79-84, map 85-87, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 120-124, spo2 96-97, temp 36.6-36.7
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 58-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
